mapper.select: select p.*, if(rp.permission_id is null, 0, 1) as selected FROM permission p left join roles_permission rp on p.id = rp.permission_id and rp.role_id = #{roleId} where p.`status`!=2 order by p.created_time desc
select count(1) FROM permission p left join roles_permission rp on p.id = rp.permission_id and rp.role_id = #{roleId} where p.`status`!=2 order by p.created_time desc

select p.*,a.name as app_name,if(p1.cou is null or p1.cou=0,0,1) as is_child
from permission p join application a on p.app_id = a.id
join roles_permission rp on rp.role_id =#{roleId} and p.id = rp.permission_id
left join ( select pid,count(1) as cou from permission where status =1 group by pid ) p1 on p.id=p1.pid where p.pid = #{pid} and p.status=1 order by p.created_time

select p.*, a.name as app_name FROM permission p join application a on p.app_id = a.id and p.app_id=#{appId} where p.`status`= 1
and p.type = #{permissionType}
and (p.name like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') or p.sign like concat('%',#{filterVal},'%') )
order by p.pid desc

select * from ( select distinct p.* from permission p join roles_permission rp on p.app_id=#{appId} and p.type=0 and p.pid=0 and p.`status`=1 and p.id = rp.role_id join role r on r.id = rp.role_id and r.`status`=1 join depts_roles dr on dr.role_id = r.id join user u on u.id = #{userId} and u.dept_id = dr.dept_id union select distinct p.* from permission p join roles_permission rp on p.app_id=#{appId} and p.type=0 and p.pid=0 and p.`status`=1 and p.id = rp.role_id join role r on r.id = rp.role_id and r.`status`=1 join groups_roles gr on gr.role_id = r.id join groups_users gu on gu.user_id=#{userId} and gr.group_id = gu.group_id union select distinct p.* from permission p join roles_permission rp on p.app_id=#{appId} and p.type=0 and p.pid=0 and p.`status`=1 and p.id = rp.role_id join role r on r.id = rp.role_id and r.`status`=1 join users_roles ur on ur.user_id=#{userId} and ur.role_id = r.id )a order by a.id
